children: U.S. officials are considering a range of measures to lower elevated diesel prices, including a possible suspension of taxes. According to Sina Finance, the discussions remain broad and no decision is expected in the near term.
According to Sina Finance, U.S. officials are also holding active and constructive talks with Iran on reopening the Strait of Hormuz, while the United States is not rushing to reach a deal.

Anthropic is in early talks to lease up to 1 gigawatt of compute capacity from a data center developer controlled by Apollo Global Management Holdings. According to Sina Finance, the company is discussing becoming a direct tenant in a Stream Data Centers project and plans to deploy TPUs designed by Broadcom and Google.

OpenAI said it notified dozens of institutions, including government departments and universities, that their websites may have been affected by access from its AI models during technical evaluations. According to Sina Finance, the company said the incidents were found during an expanded investigation.

Kansas City Fed President Jeffrey Schmid said inflation remains above the Federal Reserve's 2% target and that policymakers have not fully resolved the problem. According to Sina Finance, he said inflation has stayed above target for more than five years.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said he discussed the desirability of a stronger yen with Japan's Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama. According to Sina Finance, Bessent said a stronger yen would reflect Japan's strong economic fundamentals, while Japan's Ministry of Finance said the two reaffirmed concerns about the yen being undervalued.

title: US Officials Weigh Diesel Tax Pause as Anthropic Seeks Up to 1 Gigawatt of Compute
